objective: Qualify the exact Luna Instructor bundle against adversarial student behavior without rehearsing every ordinary lesson.
mandatory_invalidation: a live lesson exposes an unhandled Instructor failure
handhold_requirement: Every lesson receives rehearsal and fresh anonymous post-rehearsal review until an explicit graduation policy is approved.
student_actor: One Sol session simulates the declared Ninereeds developmental stage under a hidden behavior profile.
grading_separation: A fresh, separate Sol session reviews the frozen evidence. It receives anonymous teacher and student-simulator labels, current level, lesson script, log, teacher-language policy, and hash-bound wiki sources; it does not receive actor model identities or the hidden simulation profile.
teacher_language_gate: Every Luna turn binds known, frontier, instruction, and rescue language. Unlicensed language or absent comprehension checking prevents a pass.
alarm_policy: Luna or the harness may freeze a rehearsal immediately. An alarm-frozen run cannot pass and remains immutable for diagnosis.
repair_policy: A repair uses a new linked run and a receipt proving changed artifact bytes; failed and alarm-frozen evidence is never overwritten.
human_projection: Every lesson is rendered as a PDF showing actual images, captions, dialogue, answer contracts, controls, alarm conditions, and hashes; lesson JSON remains machine authority.
pass_rule: Every mandatory scenario must pass; an average cannot conceal a role, language-boundary, truth, budget, or acquisition-claim failure.
